Cell 1

Human vs NHP pipeline

Analysis of log2FC (macrophage vs microglia) for 5 target genes: GPNMB, IQGAP2, CPM, DPYD, STARD13.

Key corrections applied:

  • Dataset 8: biological donor mapping (9 donors instead of 21 samples)
  • Dataset 7: SM96_Monkey_SM45_Rep1 and SM97_Monkey_SM45_Rep2 merged into one monkey (SM45)

Cell 7

LogFC (macrophage vs microglia) calculation

The function calculates donor-level log2FC between macrophages and microglia. Data are already log-normalized.

Cell 8

In [12]
Code
def calculate_donor_logfc(adata, gene_name, macro_label,
                          cluster_col='majority_voting',
                          donor_col='sample'):
    """
    Calculates Log2FC for the gene between macrophages and microglia per donor.
    Data are assumed to be already log-normalized, so log2FC = mean_macro - mean_micro.
    """
    if gene_name not in adata.var_names:
        print(f'  Warning: {gene_name} not found, skipping.')
        return pd.DataFrame()
    
    gene_expr = adata[:, gene_name].X
    if hasattr(gene_expr, 'toarray'):
        gene_expr = gene_expr.toarray().flatten()
    else:
        gene_expr = gene_expr.flatten()
    
    results = []
    for donor in adata.obs[donor_col].unique():
        donor_mask = adata.obs[donor_col] == donor
        donor_expr = gene_expr[donor_mask]
        donor_clusters = adata.obs.loc[donor_mask, cluster_col]
        
        macro_mask = donor_clusters == macro_label
        micro_mask = ~macro_mask
        macro_expr = donor_expr[macro_mask]
        micro_expr = donor_expr[micro_mask]
        
        if len(macro_expr) == 0 or len(micro_expr) == 0:
            continue
        
        logfc = np.mean(macro_expr) - np.mean(micro_expr)
        results.append({'donor': donor, 'log2fc': logfc,
                        'n_macro': len(macro_expr), 'n_micro': len(micro_expr)})
    
    return pd.DataFrame(results)

# Dataset configurations: (adata, id, macro_label, cluster_col, donor_col, species)
dataset_configs = [
    (adata1, 'DS1', 'Macro F13A1 COLEC12', 'majority_voting', 'sample', 'Human'),
    (adata2, 'DS2', 'Macro F13A1 COLEC12', 'majority_voting', 'sample', 'Human'),
    (adata3, 'DS3', 'Macro F13A1 COLEC12', 'majority_voting', 'sample', 'Human'),
    (adata4, 'DS4', 'Macro F13A1 COLEC12', 'majority_voting', 'sample', 'Human'),
    (adata5, 'DS5', 'Macro F13A1 COLEC12', 'majority_voting', 'sample', 'Human'),
    (adata8, 'DS8', 'Macro F13A1 COLEC12', 'majority_voting', 'donor',    'Human'),
    (adata9, 'DS9', 'Macro F13A1 COLEC12', 'majority_voting', 'sample', 'Human'),
    (adata6, 'DS6', 'PVM',                 'majority_voting', 'sample', 'NHP'),
    (adata7, 'DS7', '14',                  'leiden_res_2.0',  'donor',    'NHP'),
]

TARGET_GENES = ['GPNMB', 'IQGAP2', 'CPM', 'DPYD', 'STARD13']

gene_results = {gene: {} for gene in TARGET_GENES}

for adata_obj, ds_id, macro_lbl, clst_col, dnr_col, species in dataset_configs:
    print(f'\n--- {ds_id} ({species}) ---')
    for gene in TARGET_GENES:
        result = calculate_donor_logfc(
            adata=adata_obj, gene_name=gene, macro_label=macro_lbl,
            cluster_col=clst_col, donor_col=dnr_col)
        if not result.empty:
            result['Dataset'] = ds_id
            result['Species'] = species
            gene_results[gene][ds_id] = result
            print(f'  {gene:10s}: {len(result)} donors')
        else:
            print(f'  {gene:10s}: skipped')

print('\nAll genes processed.')

Cell 11

Linear Mixed-Effects Model

We compare logFC values of all human donors against macaque donors using an LMM with Dataset as random effect.

Cell 12

In [14]
Code
lmm_summary = []

for gene in TARGET_GENES:
    all_data = [df.copy() for df in gene_results[gene].values()]
    if not all_data:
        print(f'{gene}: no data, skipping.')
        continue
    
    df_gene = pd.concat(all_data, ignore_index=True)
    model = smf.mixedlm('log2fc ~ Species', data=df_gene, groups=df_gene['Dataset'])
    result = model.fit()
    
    species_coef = result.params.get('Species[T.NHP]', np.nan)
    species_pval = result.pvalues.get('Species[T.NHP]', np.nan)
    n_human = (df_gene['Species'] == 'Human').sum()
    n_nhp = (df_gene['Species'] == 'NHP').sum()
    sig = '***' if species_pval < 0.001 else '**' if species_pval < 0.01 else '*' if species_pval < 0.05 else 'ns'
    
    lmm_summary.append({'Gene': gene, 'n_Human': n_human, 'n_NHP': n_nhp,
                        'Coef': round(species_coef, 4), 'p_value': species_pval,
                        'Significance': sig})
    
    print(f'\n{"="*60}')
    print(f'LMM: {gene} (Human vs NHP)')
    print(f'{"="*60}')
    print(f'n Human = {n_human}, n NHP = {n_nhp}')
    print(f'Species Effect: coef={species_coef:.4f}, p={species_pval:.4e} {sig}')

print(f'\n{"="*60}')
print('SUMMARY TABLE: LMM Human vs NHP')
print(f'{"="*60}')
summary_df = pd.DataFrame(lmm_summary)
summary_df['p_value'] = summary_df['p_value'].apply(lambda x: f'{x:.4e}')
print(summary_df.to_string(index=False))

Cell 13

Pooled species comparison (Human vs NHP)

Cell 14

In [15]
Code
markers = {'DS1':'o', 'DS2':'s', 'DS3':'^', 'DS4':'v', 'DS5':'D',
           'DS6':'*', 'DS7':'p', 'DS8':'h', 'DS9':'X'}
colors_map = {'Human':'skyblue', 'NHP':'coral'}

for gene in TARGET_GENES:
    all_dfs = [df.copy() for df in gene_results[gene].values()]
    if not all_dfs:
        continue
    
    plot_df = pd.concat(all_dfs, ignore_index=True)
    np.random.seed(42)
    
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6), dpi=300)
    sns.set_style('white')
    sns.boxplot(data=plot_df, x='Species', y='log2fc',
                palette=[colors_map['Human'], colors_map['NHP']],
                width=0.5, showfliers=False, linewidth=1.5, linecolor='black',
                ax=ax, zorder=2)
    
    for ds in plot_df['Dataset'].unique():
        sub = plot_df[plot_df['Dataset'] == ds]
        sp = sub['Species'].iloc[0]
        x_val = 0 if sp == 'Human' else 1
        jitter = np.random.uniform(-0.18, 0.18, size=len(sub))
        ax.scatter(x_val + jitter, sub['log2fc'],
                   marker=markers.get(ds, 'o'), c=colors_map[sp], s=50, alpha=0.85,
                   edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.3, label=f'{ds}', zorder=3)
    
    ax.axhline(0, color='black', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, linewidth=2, zorder=1)
    sns.despine(ax=ax, top=True, right=True)
    ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
    n_h = (plot_df['Species'] == 'Human').sum()
    n_n = (plot_df['Species'] == 'NHP').sum()
    ax.set_title(gene, fontsize=23, fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic', pad=20)
    ax.set_ylabel('Log2 Fold Change', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_xlabel('')
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=18)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f'Human\n(n={n_h})', f'NHP\n(n={n_n})'])
    ax.legend(title='Dataset', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=12, title_fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    np.random.seed(42)
    
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6), dpi=300)
    sns.set_style('white')
    sns.boxplot(data=plot_df, x='Species', y='log2fc',
                palette=[colors_map['Human'], colors_map['NHP']],
                width=0.5, showfliers=False, linewidth=1.5, linecolor='black',
                ax=ax, zorder=2)
    
    for ds in plot_df['Dataset'].unique():
        sub = plot_df[plot_df['Dataset'] == ds]
        sp = sub['Species'].iloc[0]
        x_val = 0 if sp == 'Human' else 1
        jitter = np.random.uniform(-0.18, 0.18, size=len(sub))
        ax.scatter(x_val + jitter, sub['log2fc'],
                   marker=markers.get(ds, 'o'), c=colors_map[sp], s=50, alpha=0.85,
                   edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.3, label=f'{ds}', zorder=3)
    
    ax.axhline(0, color='black', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, linewidth=2, zorder=1)
    sns.despine(ax=ax, top=True, right=True)
    ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
    n_h = (plot_df['Species'] == 'Human').sum()
    n_n = (plot_df['Species'] == 'NHP').sum()
    ax.set_title(gene, fontsize=23, fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic', pad=20)
    ax.set_ylabel('Log2 Fold Change', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_xlabel('')
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=18)
    ax.set_xticklabels([f'Human\n(n={n_h})', f'NHP\n(n={n_n})'])
    ax.legend(title='Dataset', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=12, title_fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

In [19]
Code
# Build Supplementary Table S3

ds_labels = {
    'DS1': 'Dataset 1 (H. sapiens)',
    'DS2': 'Dataset 2 (H. sapiens)',
    'DS3': 'Dataset 3 (H. sapiens)',
    'DS4': 'Dataset 4 (H. sapiens)',
    'DS5': 'Dataset 5 (H. sapiens)',
    'DS6': 'Dataset 6 (M. fascicularis)',
    'DS7': 'Dataset 7 (M. mulatta)',
    'DS8': 'Dataset 8 (H. sapiens)',
    'DS9': 'Dataset 9 (H. sapiens)',
}

ds_order = ['DS1', 'DS2', 'DS3', 'DS4', 'DS5', 'DS6', 'DS7', 'DS8', 'DS9']

rows = []
for ds_id in ds_order:
    label = ds_labels[ds_id]
    donors = sorted(gene_results['GPNMB'][ds_id]['donor'].unique())
    for i, donor in enumerate(donors):
        row = {'Dataset': label if i == 0 else np.nan, 'donor': donor}
        for gene in TARGET_GENES:
            donor_df = gene_results[gene][ds_id]
            val = donor_df.loc[donor_df['donor'] == donor, 'log2fc'].values
            row[gene] = val[0] if len(val) > 0 else np.nan
        rows.append(row)

supp_s3 = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['Dataset', 'donor'] + TARGET_GENES)

print(f'Supplementary Table S3 (corrected): {len(supp_s3)} donors')
print(supp_s3.to_string(index=False))

# Save
supp_s3.to_excel('Supplementary Table S3_corrected.xlsx', index=False)
supp_s3.to_csv('Supplementary Table S3_corrected.csv', index=False)
print('\\nSaved: Supplementary Table S3_corrected.xlsx / .csv')
